def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    sep=None
    for k in c:
        if any(all(g[i][j]==k for j in range(w)) for i in range(h)) and any(all(g[i][j]==k for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)):
            sep=k; break
    rest={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!=sep}
    bg=max(rest,key=rest.get)
    marker=min(rest,key=rest.get)
    srows=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==sep for j in range(w))]
    scols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    rb=[0]+[i+1 for i in srows]+[h]; cb=[0]+[j+1 for j in scols]+[w]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        row=[]
        for cc,dd in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            cnt=sum(g[i][j]==marker for i in range(a,b) for j in range(cc,dd))
            row.append(1 if cnt%2==0 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
